text: Shows a craft recipe as a card in the look of the item, skill and buff cards: the product (hover its icon or name for its tooltip card, a "Chance for 2x" tag when the recipe has one), proficiency, labor and workbench side by side, the materials (hover one for its tooltip card) with the amounts in a column, and the Recipe Cost at the bottom. A recipe that is not stored yet is shown in the older table look. Data from the sermeatball crafting API. The recipe row shows how many items one craft makes. When the craft has a bonus rate above 100 (and below 1000, since 10000 is not a percentage), a "Chance for 2x" row shows the extra percentage. Workbench, proficiency and materials come from the API. Coins in the recipe are shown last in the Materials list. A Recipe Cost row shows the total price of the materials, and is left out when the API has no price for them. Both as Gold / Silver / Copper. Usage {{RecipeBox|9001323}} The craft ID is the only required parameter. The recipe is read from a data page stored on the wiki (Module:Data/Recipes/..., made by sync_wiki_data.py). Only the Recipe Cost is fetched live, it follows the market. A recipe that is not stored yet is read live from the API until the script has been run for it. After a recipe changes in the game, run the script with --recipe ID --refresh. float (optional): where the box sits on the page. right or left places it at that side with the text flowing around it, center centres it. Leave it out for a normal box in the flow of the page. Several boxes next to each other: use RecipeRow instead of putting boxes in Div, it needs far less of the page's size limit. Examples {{RecipeBox|9001323|float=right}} {{RecipeBox|9001323|float=left}} Needs Module:RecipeBox, Template:RecipeBox/cost (the live Recipe Cost), Module:Tooltip (with its flat function), the templates Coins, Grade, Item and Tooltip (the hover cards), and the style pages Template:RecipeBox/styles.css and Template:Item/styles.css. The older table look (RecipeMaterialLine) is only the fallback. The hover cards need the items to be stored: run sync_wiki_data.py (it now stores the product and every material of a stored recipe). A box with float=right opens the hover cards to the left. On narrow screens (phones) a floated box gets its own line instead of squeezing the text. No description. html:
Shows a craft recipe as a card in the look of the item, skill and buff cards: the product (hover its icon or name for its tooltip card, a "Chance for 2x" tag when the recipe has one), proficiency, labor and workbench side by side, the materials (hover one for its tooltip card) with the amounts in a column, and the Recipe Cost at the bottom. A recipe that is not stored yet is shown in the older table look. Data from the sermeatball crafting API. The recipe row shows how many items one craft makes. When the craft has a bonus rate above 100 (and below 1000, since 10000 is not a percentage), a "Chance for 2x" row shows the extra percentage. Workbench, proficiency and materials come from the API. Coins in the recipe are shown last in the Materials list. A Recipe Cost row shows the total price of the materials, and is left out when the API has no price for them. Both as Gold / Silver / Copper.

Usage 

{{RecipeBox|9001323}}
  • The craft ID is the only required parameter.
  • The recipe is read from a data page stored on the wiki (Module:Data/Recipes/..., made by sync_wiki_data.py). Only the Recipe Cost is fetched live, it follows the market. A recipe that is not stored yet is read live from the API until the script has been run for it. After a recipe changes in the game, run the script with --recipe ID --refresh.
  • float (optional): where the box sits on the page. right or left places it at that side with the text flowing around it, center centres it. Leave it out for a normal box in the flow of the page.
  • Several boxes next to each other: use RecipeRow instead of putting boxes in Div, it needs far less of the page's size limit.

Examples 

{{RecipeBox|9001323|float=right}}
{{RecipeBox|9001323|float=left}}
  • Needs Module:RecipeBox, Template:RecipeBox/cost (the live Recipe Cost), Module:Tooltip (with its flat function), the templates Coins, Grade, Item and Tooltip (the hover cards), and the style pages Template:RecipeBox/styles.css and Template:Item/styles.css. The older table look (RecipeMaterialLine) is only the fallback.
  • The hover cards need the items to be stored: run sync_wiki_data.py (it now stores the product and every material of a stored recipe).
  • A box with float=right opens the hover cards to the left.
  • On narrow screens (phones) a floated box gets its own line instead of squeezing the text.

No description.
